fields.notes: Avalon's protocol-level DFT surface is the JTAG-to-Avalon-MM master / System Console in-system access path, the debugaccess signal, SignalTap capture, and the response/error qualifiers. Chip-level scan/BIST remain device/SoC concerns.

in_band_test_facilities.name: JTAG-to-Avalon-MM master
in_band_test_facilities.purpose: Intel debug fabric issues Avalon-MM read/write transfers from JTAG for in-system register/memory access.

in_band_test_facilities.name: System Console
in_band_test_facilities.purpose: Scriptable Avalon-MM access for bring-up and debug.

in_band_test_facilities.name: debugaccess signal
in_band_test_facilities.purpose: Marks an Avalon-MM transfer as a debug access so agents can permit restricted accesses.

in_band_test_facilities.name: SignalTap
in_band_test_facilities.purpose: On-chip capture of Avalon signals (handshake, data) for debug.

in_band_test_facilities.name: Response / error qualifiers
in_band_test_facilities.purpose: Avalon-MM response and Avalon-ST error report transfer/data faults.

out_of_band_test_facilities: Quartus / Platform Designer simulation BFMs and protocol checkers.
Vendor JTAG debug (System Console, JTAG-to-Avalon-MM master).
